name: singlet_cell_state_developmental_potency_scoring
title: Developmental potency scoring
description: Scores each cell's developmental potency from one transcriptome on a 0-1 scale within the dataset, higher meaning more primitive, and writes the raw statistic of the chosen method. The default cytotrace needs only counts; scent_sr and ccat need a PPI adjacency and a normalised layer; stemid_entropy is per-cell entropy only. Use dry_run first on large data. Do not use it to assign fates or root cells, or to compare absolute scores across datasets; use potency_raw for that.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Scoring rule. cytotrace is the default; scent_sr and ccat need ppi_network and a normalised layer; stemid_entropy is per-cell entropy only.

layer.description: Expression layer read. Keep counts for cytotrace and stemid_entropy; scent_sr and ccat need a normalised layer such as lognorm.

log_transform.description: Apply log2(x + pseudocount) before scent_sr or ccat; set true only when the layer holds size-normalised counts.

ppi_network.description: Symmetric gene-by-gene PPI adjacency as a uns key or file path; required for scent_sr and ccat; largest component used.

cytotrace.description: CytoTRACE options: number of top-correlated genes averaged and the aggregation rule.

n_genes.description: Number of top positively correlated genes averaged into the score.

aggregation.description: Aggregation of the selected genes' expression per cell.

scent.description: SCENT options: minimum overlap with the PPI and the log pseudocount used when log_transform is true.

min_overlap_genes.description: Stop if fewer genes are shared with the PPI than this.

log_pseudocount.description: Pseudocount c in log2(x + c) for scent_sr.

ccat.description: CCAT options: minimum overlap with the PPI and the log pseudocount.

min_overlap_genes.description: Stop if fewer genes are shared with the PPI than this.

log_pseudocount.description: Pseudocount c in log2(x + c) for ccat.

pseudocount.description: Pseudocount added inside the logarithm of the gene-share entropy.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/potency_score. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, n_cells, n_top_genes (cytotrace), ppi_overlap_genes and lambda_max (network methods), score_min, score_max.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
